sections.title: باب 7 — متن (11)

paras.text: For variety or difference the word “Diversity” is used in English. This word, by way of the French language, is derived from the Greek word “Diversus”, which means “many, more than one or of many kinds”. Diversity means such a series or variety of many individuals or things which are different from one another. The Encarta Encyclopedia has defined it somewhat like this: “Diversity means different kinds of something, e.g. opinion, colour and style etc.” Diversity or difference is generally taken in these meanings: “ethnic, social including economic and gender kinds etc. in some group, society or institution.” Feroz-ul-Lughat has stated the meaning of diversity as variety, being of many kinds and being of different colours. In fact it means a collection of people different in ethnicities, socially and economically, or difference on the basis of gender etc. That society is called a diverse society which is a collection of different ethnicities, languages, cultures and economic classes etc. In the world there are many such countries, or within one country such societies, where there is no ethnic, social, religious, gender and economic uniformity. Such a society is called a diverse or differentiated society. It has advantages as well as disadvantages. For example, in such societies there is a possibility of a lack of law and order. Here social relationships are not strong; tolerance and acceptance are not seen; there is a lack of sacrifice; social and cultural activities are few and the possibility of corruption is greater. However, in such societies a trend of positive competition is found, and here problems created by kinship groups do not exist.

Diversity

For variety or difference the word “Diversity” is used in English. This word, by way of the French language, is derived from the Greek word “Diversus”, which means “many, more than one or of many kinds”. Diversity means such a series or variety of many individuals or things which are different from one another. The Encarta Encyclopedia has defined it somewhat like this: “Diversity means different kinds of something, e.g. opinion, colour and style etc.” Diversity or difference is generally taken in these meanings: “ethnic, social including economic and gender kinds etc. in some group, society or institution.” Feroz-ul-Lughat has stated the meaning of diversity as variety, being of many kinds and being of different colours. In fact it means a collection of people different in ethnicities, socially and economically, or difference on the basis of gender etc. That society is called a diverse society which is a collection of different ethnicities, languages, cultures and economic classes etc. In the world there are many such countries, or within one country such societies, where there is no ethnic, social, religious, gender and economic uniformity. Such a society is called a diverse or differentiated society. It has advantages as well as disadvantages. For example, in such societies there is a possibility of a lack of law and order. Here social relationships are not strong; tolerance and acceptance are not seen; there is a lack of sacrifice; social and cultural activities are few and the possibility of corruption is greater. However, in such societies a trend of positive competition is found, and here problems created by kinship groups do not exist.

Prejudice

A pre-prepared and unproven decision or opinion in favour of or against an individual or group is called prejudice. In the modern world prejudice means adopting an unfavourable and hostile attitude with others because of some ideology or membership of a social or ethnic group. Racial bigotry too is called prejudice. An important feature of it is also the attempt to prove the status of the opposing individual or group as lesser and inferior. In one and the same society the superior and majority ethnic group maintains a prejudiced attitude towards some minority and inferior group. In this same way discriminations are born. سٹیریو ٹائپ کا مطلب دو زاویوں سے سمجھنا ضروری ہے۔ ایڈوانس آکسفورڈ ڈکشنری اور مائیکروسافٹ اِنسائیکلوپیڈیا اِنکارٹا نے اِسکا مطلب یہ بیان کیا ہے کہ کسی فرد یا گروہ کی اصلیت کو مسخ شدہ انداز میں پیش کرنا یا اہم حقائق کو نظرانداز کرتے ہوئے اِس طرح سادہ و سہل انداز میں پیش کرنا کہ معنی بدل جائیں۔ کسی کی اصلیت کو مسخ شدہ اور حقائق کے برعکس درجے تک کم کرنا سٹیریو ٹائپ ہے۔ آکسفورڈ ڈکشنری نے اِس کی تعریف یوں کی ہے ”کسی شخص یا چیز کے بارے میں ایک ایسا مستقل خیال جو حقیقت میں درست نہ ہو۔“ مثال کے طور پر نسلی سٹیریو ٹائپ افراد کے ایک گروہ کے رویئے، شخصیت اور شکل و شباہت کی بناء پر حقائق کو کم اور مسخ شدہ خصوصیات کے ساتھ پیش کرنا ہے جیسا کہ ایک مخصوص نسلی گروہ کو بے کار، بے وقوف، بددیانت اور پُرتشدد وغیرہ کے طور پر پیش کیا جائے جبکہ اصل میں وہ گروہ ایسا نہ ہو۔ بعض اہم افراد، اِداروں اور گروہوں کو اُن کی حیثیت سے کم بیان کیا جاتا ہے تاکہ اُن کی قیمت پر اپنے آپ کو بڑھا چڑھا کر پیش کیا جائے۔ یہ ایک اِنتہائی غیر اِنسانی فعل ہے کیونکہ محنت، جدوجہد اور سخت کام کوئی اور کرے اور فائدہ کوئی اور لینے کی کوشش کرے۔ نہ صرف فائدہ لے بلکہ اصلی فرد یا گروہ کو بدنام یا کمزور بھی ثابت کیا جائے۔ ہم روزمرہ کی زندگی میں دیکھتے ہیں کہ گھر میں ایک کارنامہ کوئی اور سرانجام دیتا ہے لیکن اِس پر شاباش یا اِنعام و اکرام کوئی اور حاصل کرنے کی کوشش کرتا ہے۔ نہ صرف یہ بلکہ اصلی فرد کو بدنام بھی کیا جاتا ہے۔ پسماندہ ممالک میں یہ عمل سیاسی مقاصد کیلئے بھی کیا جاتا ہے۔

اِس کا دوسرا مطلب لکیر کا فقیر ہونا ہے جیسا کہ چم ایڈوانس ڈکشنری نے بیان کیا ہے۔ اِس سے مراد وہ فرد یا گروہ جو لکیر کا فقیر ہو اور کسی بھی قسم کی تبدیلی یا سماجی تغیر کا مخالف ہو۔ ایسے لوگ غیر لچکدار اور سخت سوچ کے ہوتے ہیں اور ملکی ترقی میں اِن کا کوئی خاص حصہ نہیں ہوتا۔ یہ لوگ اور گروہ ایک ہی ڈگر پر قائم رہتے ہیں۔

… many forms, for example the prejudice of capitalists with one another, or the prejudice of capitalists against the poor class. Office, social rank, cultural supremacy, superiority in knowledge and religion etc. are such things as can become the cause of prejudice. Solidarity is such a thing through which prejudice can be ended or reduced.

Stereotype

It is necessary to understand the meaning of stereotype from two angles. The Advanced Oxford Dictionary and Microsoft Encyclopedia Encarta have stated its meaning as presenting the reality of an individual or group in a distorted manner, or, ignoring important facts, presenting it in such a simple and easy manner that the meaning changes. Reducing someone’s reality to a distorted degree contrary to facts is stereotype. The Oxford Dictionary has defined it thus: “A fixed idea about some person or thing which is not correct in reality.” For example, ethnic stereotype is presenting the facts about the behaviour, personality and appearance of a group of individuals as reduced and with distorted characteristics, as when a particular ethnic group is presented as useless, foolish, dishonest and violent etc., while in reality that group is not so. Some important individuals, institutions and groups are described as less than their status so that oneself may be exaggerated at their cost. This is an extremely inhuman act, because labour, struggle and hard work are done by someone else and someone else tries to take the benefit. Not only take the benefit, but the real individual or group is also proved defamed or weak. In daily life we see that at home some feat is accomplished by someone, but someone else tries to obtain praise or reward for it. Not only this, but the real individual is also defamed. In backward countries this act is also done for political purposes.

Its second meaning is being a blind follower of tradition (“a beggar of the line”), as Chambers Advanced Dictionary has stated. By this is meant that individual or group which is a follower of the beaten track and is opposed to any kind of change or social change. Such people are inflexible and of rigid thinking, and they have no special share in national development. These people and groups remain on one and the same track.
